name: Graphic Designer

sections.daily_work: Create visual concepts using typography, color, and layout. Design logos, posters, branding materials, and digital interfaces for clients and companies.
sections.learning: Design principles, color theory, typography, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), UI/UX fundamentals, portfolio development.
sections.pay: Varies by location and experience. Entry-level often starts around $35,000-$50,000 USD. Freelance rates vary widely. Always verify current data for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Graphic design degree or certificate, self-learning with online tutorials, portfolio-based hiring, internships at design studios or agencies.

try_in_real_life: Design a logo for a fictional brand using free tools like Canva or GIMP
Create a poster for a school or community event
Study color theory by analyzing ads and packaging you see daily
Build a portfolio of 5-10 design pieces and share online
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Outlook Handbook (bls.gov/ooh)
